title: einsum：批量矩阵乘与轴约简
expected_output:
batch shape = (2, 3, 3)
matches loop = True
sum last axis matches = True
code:
import numpy as np
X = np.arange(24, dtype=np.float64).reshape(2, 3, 4)
Y = np.arange(24, dtype=np.float64).reshape(2, 4, 3)
Z = np.einsum('bij,bjk->bik', X, Y)
print("batch shape =", Z.shape)
ref = np.stack([X[k] @ Y[k] for k in range(2)])
print("matches loop =", np.allclose(Z, ref))
S = np.einsum('bij->bi', X)
print("sum last axis matches =", np.allclose(S, X.sum(axis=2)))
